description: Use when someone says what they need their music to help them do next: focus or get into deep work, get ready for a game, workout, meeting or performance, reset when they are running low and the day is not over, or come down and recover after the hard thing is done. Maps that stated goal to one of CHRP’s four public states (Flow, Ready, Recharge, Recover) and returns bounded guidance on using music for it, with CHRP’s public sources and the limits of the evidence. Guidance only: it does not measure, score, infer how the person is doing now, draw any clinical conclusion, or explain a specific song. If the goal is unclear it returns one short question. Not for trivia, playlist generation, or entertainment-only requests.

goal.description: What the person explicitly said they need their music to help them do next, in their own words (for example “I need to lock in and write for two hours” or “help me come down after the game”). Not a description of their mood, and not a song.

service.description: The listening service the person uses, if they said so: apple_music, spotify, or unknown.

name: guide_music_intent
